tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// zhal gdams tshigs su bcad pa'i rim pa bdud rtsi'i gter zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// shrī ya se stu/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba las sgrol zhes// rgyal ba'i spyan sngar dam bcas srid pa ru// yang yang skye rabs 'phreng bzung sprul pa yis// rtag tu gzhan don byed pa pad dkar gyis// 'jig rten bya ba rgyab tu bskyur byas nas// dben pa'i ri bo rnams su bsam gtan la// rtse gcig gzhol bar 'dod pa'i spong ba pa'i// tshogs la phan pa'i gtam tshig cung zad springs// dal 'byor mi lus shin tu rnyed dka' yang*// sngon bsag mthu las lan gcig thob dus 'dir// stong log ma byed gtan bde sgrub pa'i phyir// sgrub pa snying por long zhig spong ba pa// rtswa kha'i zil pa 'dra ba'i tshe srog 'di// nam 'jig nges pa med na rnam g.yeng dang*// snyom las le lo dor ba'i dus lags pas// smra bcad 'dag sbyar gyis shig bsam gtan pa// sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi 'dra ba'i zang zing rdzas// ji tsam bsags kyang snying po med pa'i phyir// bdog pa mi gtsang lud bzhin dor byas te// ri khrod dben pa sten cig sgom chen pa// nye 'brel mdza' bshes tshong 'dus mgron po bzhin// lan gcig 'dus kyang myur du 'bral nges na// sdug bsngal ma lus skyed pa'i rten gyur pa// chags dang zhen pa spongs shig rnal 'byor pa// srid pa'i rgya mtsho gting ring 'dir tshud nas// yun ring thal kyang da res thar pa yi// go skabs cung zad rnyed dus dam pa'i chos// brtson 'grus drag pos sgrubs dang ri khrod pa// rgyal bas yon tan ma lus bla ma las// 'byung bar 'gyur zhes gsungs pas gsol 'debs shing*// dam pa kun gyi rnam thar rjes zhugs nas// chos bzhin rtag tu spyod dang bya btang tsho// stong pa nyid dang snying rje'i snying po can// bsam du med pa gnyug ma'i rnal 'byor la// rtag tu mnyam par 'jog cing snang grags kun// rang bzhin shes pas spyod dang chos pa rnams// zhes pa mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas mchog cig car dpal gyi nags ljongs su sgrub pa'i sder/

thog mar brdzangs pa'i sgom chen rnams la gdams pa'o// ༈ gros 'debs kyi tshig le'ur byas pa snying gi gdung ba 'joms byed legs bshad bdud rtsi'i gter zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ 'dzam klung gser gyi ri bo 'dra ba'i sku// nyi ma brgya ltar mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar bas// 'jig rten mchod 'os kun gyi dregs 'joms pa// bcom ldan lha yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba'i nyon mongs nad rnams ma lus pa// kun nas sel byed dam chos bdud rtsi'i gter// bshad sgrub nor bu'i yol gor rab bzung nas// ris med sbyin mdzad rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gnod byed rnams la brtse ba lhag par rgyas// khro bas rtsub la ras bal 'dab bzhin 'jam// sdang bas gdung la ga bur ltar bsil ba'i// yongs 'dzin ngag gi dbang pos rtag tu skyongs// rgyal ba'i snying rje ngang pa'i rgyal po ni// yang yang 'gro ba'i yid mtshor 'jug pa de// thos pas ngal gso'i dpyid du rab 'gyur ba'i// legs par bshad pa'i glu dbyangs 'di len no// bsod nams yangs pa'i tshong zong gis thob pa// bdud rtsi'i khang par 'os pa'i rin chen snod// yon tan bgrang yas tshogs kyi rten gcig pu// mi gtsang skyon rnams blug nas dor ma byed// mtshan mo glog 'gyu yud tsam snang byed bzhin// sdug bsngal drag pos gzir ba'i skye mang las// thengs cig dal 'byor tshang ba'i lus thob pa// don med chud zos btang na ga la rung*// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho sgrol ba'i gru bo che// mi dge'i sta res gshags na slan chad ni// ngal ba ji tsam byas kyang rnyed mi 'gyur// da res phan pa 'tshol ba'i skabs yin no// skad cig phyi ma nyid du mi shi ba'i// gdeng thob med pa rtag tu sdod grabs kyis// mal gyi mtha' mar mi zad 'gyod pas gdungs// 'dus byas mi rtag soms la lha chos gyis// kha drag dpung dang gnyen mang blo gros che// 'od yangs tsha bor 'gran bzod nor ldan kyang*// 'chi dus phan pa chos las gzhan med pas// 'jig rten bya ba mchil ma'i thal bzhin spongs// legs byas smin pa'i 'byor pas phyug gyur kyang*// da lta dbang yod dus su ma spyad na// ser snas ngan 'gro'i dong du rtag tu ltung*// bsags tshad sbyin par gtong ba mi 'thad dam// longs spyod phal cher lus sems zug rngu'i rgyu// 'bad pas bsgrubs kyang dgos pa je mang 'gro// bsags na zin med brlag pa mi bzod pa'i// sdug bsngal phung po'i gzhi de bskyur la thongs// slu 'drid thabs kyis sdig la sbyor mkhas pa'i// gnyen dang mdza' 'khor skyid dus yid nye yang*// rgud na dgra bo'i thog mar ldang nges pas// nye du'i 'brel ba rbad kyis chod la zhog

/gzhon nu lang tsho dar la bab pa'i skabs// tshe 'di'i sgyu thabs kho na'i dbang song na// rgas nas dka' thub spyad pa ji ltar nus// da lta snyom sems skyung ba'i dus tshod yin// srid dang zhi ba'i dge legs ji snyed pa// mtshan ldan bla ma'i drin las gzhan min na// mi mnyes mi byed mnyes par bya ba la// dus rnam kun tu 'bad pa chen pos sgrubs// yon tan kun gyi gzhi ma tshul khrims yin// 'chal na skye ba 'bum mang log par lhung*// des na tshul gnas thos bsam sgom pa yi// thub pa'i bstan la snying po blang bar byos// rtag tu rang don byas pas 'khor ba pa// las kyi nyes pas yang yang 'khor bar 'khyams// mgon rnams gzhan bde mdzad pas zhi ba brnyes// de bas bdag gzhan don gnyis bsgrub la 'bod// sdug bsngal las ngan 'dzad pas shin tu dga'// kun gyi gnod pa bdag gis 'khur bar bya// skyid na dkon mchog mthu yin bde ba de// 'gro ba kun la nye ring med par dgos// ser sna'i zhags pa sbyin pa'i ral gris chod// 'dod sred chu bo tshul khrims gru yis sgrol// khong khro'i me phung bzod pa'i chu yis gsod// le lo'i 'dam rdzab brtson 'grus shugs kyis rgol// rnam rtog dri ma bsam gtan chu yis khrus// gti mug mun par shes rab sgron me spor// tshul 'dis srid rgyun bcad nas zhi bar 'gro// de ni rgyal rnams gshegs pa'i them skas yin// thar pa'i grong khyer che la myur 'jug na// smin byed dbang thob rim gnyis zung 'jug gis// rtsa rlung thig le sbyangs pas sku dang gsung*// thugs kyi rdo rje 'grub par byed pa yin// mdor na mdo rgyud kun gyi snying po'i don// phyag rgya chen po zer ba'i sgra bo che// mngon gsum gtan la 'bebs pa'i gdams ngag ni// rgyal dbang bka' brgyud yab sras 'di skad gsung*// don med rtsom dang mu cor smra ba sogs// phyag dar khrod kyi rtswa bzhin dor byas te// sems kyi glang po dran pa'i lcags kyus gzung*// mi sdod 'gros par rtsom na ci bder glod// dper na ma dkrugs chu bo dwangs pa bzhin// dmigs gtad bzos bcos med pa'i dran pas rig

/rab zhi bde ba ro myang med pas bskyang*// glo bur rnam rtog rgya yan bzhag pas grol// rmugs bying 'dam la dran pa'i stobs kyis brgal// rgod de bcing ba med pa nyid kyis zhi// de ltar gnas 'gyu'i bar lag 'gyel ba la// rtse gcig rnal 'byor yin zhes bla ma gsungs// thag pa nag po dug sbrul ji lta ba// de ltar 'khor ba rtog pas btags pa'i chos// gang la a 'thas dbang gis bden par snang*// de nyid spangs pas grol ba ma yin kyang*// rang gi mtshan nyid mthong bas rdzun phugs zhig /gang shar steng du lta ba man ngag yin// 'di yin yod min med min gnyis ka min// gnyis min ma yin spros dang bral bar shes// de tshe 'dzin pa dag par gyur pa yin// de dus chos kun sgyu mar mngon sum mthong*// de la 'khrul grol bar lag 'gyel bar smra// de nyid spros bral rnal 'byor yin zhes bshad// sems la glo bur ma rig las nyon mongs// sdug bsngal sna tshogs med bzhin snang mod kyang*// snang dus nyid nas stong ste ma grub shes// ji ltar rmi lam sna tshogs myong na yang*// ma grub sad tshe rtogs pa ji bzhin no// 'dzam bu'i gling gi chu bo ji snyed pa// rgya mtshor zhugs tshe dbyer med ro gcig 'gyur// rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i chos thams cad// chos sku'i rol pa gcig tu song ba la// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa tha snyad tsam// blang dang dor ba'i dgag sgrub ga la yod// de ltar snang sems bar lag 'gyel ba la// ro gcig rnal 'byor zhes par rje btsun gsungs// thams cad khyab brdal yug cig gyur pa yis// bsgom bya sgom byed blo zad chos zad thal// sgyu ma mkhas pas sgyu ma'i dngos med par// sna tshogs sgyu ma sprul pa ji bzhin du// sgrib pa kun dang bral bar gyur pa las// bden gnyis dbyer med rnam 'phrul mtha' yas pa// smon lam snying rje'i dbang gis chos dbyings dang*// gnyis med gcig tu 'char bar 'gyur ba yis// de yis 'gro ba'i phan pa thams cad mdzad// mnyam rjes bar lag 'gyer ba 'di yin la// sgom du med pa rnal 'byor 'di ka rang*// de ltar zab mo dbye ba'i dge ba des// de nyid 'gro ba rnams kyis legs rtogs shing*// rtag tu 'gro ba'i don la mi skyo bas// byang chub snying por myur du mchis gyur cig

/thub pa'i bstan pa mngon par dga' ba'i tshal// gang du bshad dang sgrub pa'i zlos gar gyis// rnam rol bde ba'i dpal la chas gyur pa'i// slob bu'i tshogs la brtse bas 'di bsgrags so// zhes pa shar kong po'i yul ljongs kyi sa yi cha/ sgrub pa'i sde thub bstan mngon par dga' ba'i tshal du bsam gtan kho na lhur len pa bla ma dge slong dpal 'byor legs pas mgo byas rnams lam chas pa dang nye ba'i dus shākya'i dge slong mi pham pad+ma dkar po phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/ gtsang myang smad kyi cha g.ya' lung gi ri bo'i mgul du thun mong gi lo sa ga can gyi dkar po cha yi rgyal ba gnyis pa la sbyar ba'o// ༈ mkhas grub chen po'i bzhed dang mi 'gal ba'i// don dang don min rnam par dbye ba ni// mi phyed tshig tshogs blo la yod pa rang*// mkhas pa min no tshig don srang la gzhol// 'khor bar drid cing 'chi bas 'jigs pa yis// sdom gsum la gus thos bsam sgom la 'grus// de 'dra mi snang tshugs khyer legs pa de// btsun pa min no chos dang zhu tig gyis// cir snang sems dang sems nyid gzhi rtsas stong*// stong nyid gdangs la kun rdzob rten 'byung shar// de las phyir phyogs rgyu 'bras khyad gsod tshe// bzang ba min no kha dang zhe phugs bstun// kun tu dran pas sems kho 'khyams mi 'jug /shar ba'i mod la grol nas mi 'gro na// ri phug 'dag sgo byas pa rkyang pa yis// sgom chen min no yengs med glod la zhog /dman pa'i sa bzung hrul po'i gos gyon cing*// lto la gyong 'khur gtam la mi rtsig kyang*// skyid 'dod re ba'i mgo bo ma chog na// bya btang min no zhe 'dod ther la phud// lus la na tsha sems steng khams 'dus dang*// brdeg 'tshog 'chi la nye ba gang la yang*// ro snyoms lam khyer gdengs dang mi ldan na// rtogs ldan min no rkyen thog brdzis la thong*// blos byas mtshan ma'i chos spyod thams cad kyang*// rang gi ngo bos stong bzhin mi spyod par// spyod log tho co che ba'i rtsing hral de// rnal 'byor pa min thabs shes zung 'jug sgoms// go na chos rnams kun gyi gnad mtshang yod// ma go rgyal ba'i gsung yang dal bar lus// phan pa'i gtam la nyan mkhan shin tu dkon// mi nyan bslab bya byed pa shin tu mang*// dpal spos skya'i bsam gtan skyong ba rnams la pad+ma dkar pos gdams pa'o//

༈ snying gtam nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa yid kyi thur ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ bsngags 'os yon tan kun gyis mdzes pa'i mgon// 'bad med gzhan don mdzad cing rtag bzhugs pa// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi dbang po thugs rje'i gter// de ring bdag la dge legs stsal du gsol// re dogs zhags pas dam por bcings pa dang*// 'khor ba'i btson ra nyam nga'i khrod 'di nas// da res ma bros phyis nas thar dka' bas// phan mdzad gsung bzhin sgrubs shig snying gtam yin// srid pa'i sdug bsngal myong nas yun ci tsam// lha mi'i dbang phyug thob kyang slad mar ni// dmyal me bzod dkas 'tshod par 'gyur ba la// bsams kyis skyo bas mi tshugs snying gtam yin// dmyal ba gshin rje'i 'jig rten dud 'gro dang*// lha mi dag gi skye ba gang yin de// gnod pa drag po'i rten du gyur pas na// yang srid med na legs so snying gtam yin// dus bzhi'i 'gyur ba mi rtag ston pa'i brda// thog rgyag shi ba nges med bskul ma ste// phyi tshigs bsgrub pa'i ngang ring mi khom pas// rings par lha chos ran no snying gtam yin// chu bur rlung gis bskyod 'dra'i gnod mang tshe// don med ngal ba zhig la ma skyel bar// glo bur mgo la me shor zlog pa lta'i// 'chi chos rem pa 'thad do snying gtam yin// longs spyod g.yo zhing snying po med pa 'di// 'tshol ba sdug la 'byor na ser sna'i ngang*// mtha' ma sus za med pas gang byung ba// ci dgar khyer nas thongs dang snying gtam yin// dge ba'i las lam bcu yi lus ngag yid// brel bar bcos nas 'dod pa'i sde rnams tsho// mi gtsang gong bur ltos la yid 'byung bas// kun tu chog shes brten pa snying gtam yin// bre mos tshig dang dgos med 'chal pa'i gtam// mdzangs pas smad 'os spyod pa kun bskyungs te// gleng ngam bya ba'i sngon du sems brtags la// blang dang dor ba mdzes so snying gtam yin// sems ni g.yo ba col chung pra lag mkhan// bdud kyi rgyu ma'i rjes su 'brang bas na// dran dang shes bzhin bag yod sgo chod la// gang du'ang yan du ma gtong snying gtam yin// snyigs ma'i skye bo 'khang skyen mgu dka' bas// kun gyi mi phya'i spyod pa mi shes kyang*// 'dul ba bzhin du rang gis ma khrel ba// dgos kyis gzhan zer mi nyan snying gtam yin// 'di nas byang chub snying por ma sleb bar// dkon mchog gsum las skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas// legs nyes kun la blos gtad des chog gis// skyob byed gzhan nas mi tshol snying gtam yin// bdag las gzhan ches 'phangs shing rang las gzhan// phan byed mchog tu shes pas gzhan don phyir// rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pas sems skyed pas// bsod nams mtha' yas thob pa snying gtam yin// mgo la sems can khur de khyer ma thag

/mtha' yas nyes las bzlog cing 'ching ba can// rnam grol bya ba brtson pa thams cad kyis// rab tu 'bad par gdams pa snying gtam yin// dge ba'i bshes la chos nyan ji bzhin bsgrub// theg gsum mkhas nas rang gi theg pa la// snying por byed pa shan ti de ba'i gsung*// spyod 'jug sogs ltar bslab pa snying gtam yin// dad pa dkar po'i chos kun skyed pa'i zhing*// khrims gtsang 'jig rten kun gyis mchod 'os te// gtong bas kun tu dbul ba sel byed pas// gsum 'di mig ltar skyong ba snying gtam yin// thos pas the tshom spyod cing don min spong*// khrel yod nyes pa kun gyis gos mi srid// ngo tshas legs spyad lhag par 'phel bgyid pas// srog bas gces par bsrung ba snying gtam yin// shes rab nyon mongs pa dang shes bya yi// sgrib pa'i ri bo 'joms pa'i tho ba ste// de ltar 'phags nor yon tan kun gyi mdzod// skyo med bsgrub pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin// bu gcig po la ma yis bya ba bzhin// sems can kun la phan pa bdag gis bya// de ched dmyal bar gnas pa rab dga' na// gzhan la spro ba ches 'jug snying gtam yin// byams la khong khro snying rje gnod sems dang*// gang gi ngor byed re la slu ba'i blo// 'gal ba yin pas gnod pa bzod byas nas// ngan len bzang pos 'jal ba snying gtam yin// kha cig pha ma la la dpon dang rigs// 'ga' zhig 'dod dang nor yul dbang song bas// dam chos mi khom kun kyang thabs mkhas kyis// dge la sprod par 'tshal lo snying gtam yin// chos byed kun kyang rkyen ngan drag po dang*// rnyed sogs brgyad kyi 'tshe bas gtses 'gyur bas// dus der gnyen pos mgo snyoms ma byas na// dgos kar bslab pa yin no snying gtam yin// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i chu bo chen po 'di// rtsad nas ma mchis ma byas de srid du// sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skems par mi 'gyur bas// bdag lta'i dgra bo thul cig snying gtam yin// sems nyid rtag tu 'od gsal dri mas bsgribs// dri ma glo bur byung bas ther zug min// yang dag nyid kyis ltos dang glo bur bas// stong pa'i de nyid rtogs pa snying gtam yin// brjod par nus min blo yi yul ma yin// bla mas bstan du med mod 'on kyang 'di// rang babs bzhag pas rjen par mthong bas na// so so rang rig yin no snying gtam yin// blta bya lta byed gnyis 'dzin lta ba ste// bzang yang sgro btags yin pas blos mi thub// gnas lugs rang gi rig pa'i lta ba 'di// med na skyon zhes gsungs so snying gtam yin// dri ma zad pa'i rtogs ngo'i snang cha la// chos can kun rdzob bden dang gshis kyi tshul// chos nyid don dam bden par bzhag byas nas/

bden gnyis dbyer med bshad do snying gtam yin// tshul des snang stong rig stong gsal stong dang*// bde stong stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug rnams// mtshon par nus shing 'khor 'das dbyer med dang*// rnam rtog chos sku'ang go ba snying gtam yin// bstan pa 'dzin phyir thos pas mi ngoms mdzod// thos tsam don mthong mi 'gyur sgom pa gnad// ma thos sgom pa'ang 'bras med nyid yin pas// tshul de rang bzhin sbyor ba snying gtam yin// de skad grub pa'i gtsug rgyan 'brug pa zhes// sa la gsal bar grags pa'i ring lugs pa// phun tshogs bod yul shar gyi btsun pa ni// pad+ma dkar po zhes byas bsgrags pa yin// zhes snying gtam nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa yid kyi thur ma zhes bya ba/ slob dpon myang stod rab 'byams pa kun dga' chos dar grub pa'i 'byung gnas ra lung thel nas/ chos sde dpal 'khor bde chen pa'i mngon dga' grwa tshang gi slob dpon du 'byon par chas pa'i tshe/ gdan sa chen po me tog mdangs 'phrog de nyid kyi ste ba/ ri bo gru 'dzin gyi ngogs spos ngad ldan pa'i zhing khams kyi rtse mo/ dka' thub pa'i bsti gnas/ bsam gtan gyi khang pa dbyangs can snang bar/ lcags pho khyi lo hor zla dgu pa'i tshes lnga'i nyin gdams pa'o// ༈ rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo// bsam gyis mi khyab tha snyad kun las ches brgal bas// ji bzhin brjod la thams cad mkhyen pa'ang dbul gyur pa// gzhon nu ma yi snying la zhen pa'i bde ba ltar// sus kyang bstan du med kyi rang gi rig par byos// grogs dag dngos po kun gyi byed po las// las de gang gi byas na rang gi sems// sems ni kun tu btsal bas 'ga' mi rnyed// rnyed min de la don dam zhes byar btags// rab rib dbang gi skra shad rnam brtags pa// mig dag skyes bus 'bad pa brgya phrag gis// mthong min de nyid yang dag mthong ba zhes// 'jig rten ji ltar smra ba de bzhin no// gang phyir skye ba cung zad yod min pas// 'gag dang gnas pa yod pa'ang ma yin no// de bzhin stong min yod pa'ang ma yin pas// stong nyid kyang ni yod par ga la 'gyur// kye ma bla ma'i byin rlabs ma thob par// de yis lhan cig skyes pa ji ltar myong*// de phyir mos gus chen pos 'o dod kyis// tha mal shes pa snying dbus sad par nges// kye kye grogs dag byas pa thams cad ni// don med sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i rgyur 'gyur bas// sgom dang sgom pa thams cad yongs dor la// bsam du med pa gnyug ma'i ngang la zhog

/gang zhig yul la rnam par 'phro ba'i sems// ji ltar chu la chu bzhag bzhin du 'am// gang nas byung zhing gang du gnas pa dang*// gang du nub pa ltos dang gzhi rtsa bral// des na snang zhing grags pa 'di las gzhan// stong nyid yod ces pad dkar mi smra zhing*// gdong du 'bab pa srid zhi'i rol pa rnams// bde ba chen po gcig tu bsgyur zhig lo// skra rtse tsam du phra ba'i zhen pas kyang*// sdug bsngal chen po 'di kun sbyar byas pas// gang la 'dod cing sred pa de bor la// chu bo rgyun bzhin mnyam par zhog dang kye// gang yang 'dzin pa bral ba'i sems ni rtogs gyur pa// thams cad de yin de las gzhan zhig mi rnyed pas// spang du med cing blang bar bya ba'ang ma mchis la// re ba zad pas dogs pa'ang ring du bros nas song*// ji ltar nags la mched pa'i me lce la// shugs drag 'thor ba'i rlung ni mdza' bor 'gyur// de ltar 'gro rnams rtag tu 'ching byed pa'i// yul 'di rnams kyi nus pa des grol lo// ma brtags shin tu nyams dga' kun rdzob chos// sgyu mas sprul pa'i glang po ji lta bar// med bzhin snang la snang bzhin ma grub pa'i// rang mtshang rig na su zhig 'ching bar 'gyur// rmi lam rmis pa de ngor grub pa dang*// sad na rdzun pa de ltar dngos kun kyang*// gti mug gnyid log de srid bden pa dang*// gnyid sad na ni med pa kho na'o// thabs dang shes rab yan gar bas// srid pa'i pha mthar bgrod pa min// gnyis po mnyam par sbyor byed na// srid dang zhi la mi gnas so// chos rnams thams cad gdod nas stong pa'i rang bzhin du// mthong bas mi dmigs bzhin du 'gro ba mgon med rnams// sgrol bar bya phyir snying rje'i dbang gis sbyin sogs la// lhag par brtson pa de ni de bzhin gshegs// yid bzhin nor bu bzhin du 'bad med par// 'gro ba'i re ba ma lus rdzogs byed pa'i// zab dang rgya che'i yon tan kun gyi gter// rdo rje 'chang dbang sa la phyag bgyi'o// de skad gangs ri khrod kyi spong ba pa// pad+ma dkar po zhes pa'i ming can gyis// mang bar bshad pa spang ba'i blang dor du// bde ba tsam zhig slob bu'i don du bkod// ces grub pa'i 'byung gnas ra lung thil gyi dpal spos skya'i yang dben nas/

tsa ri tra nyams rtogs gcig tu 'char ba'i ljongs su bsgom par chas pa'i slob ma 'ga' la gdams pa snying gi khu ba'o// ༈ pad+ma dkar po'i gtam rang gzhan gyi bskul 'debs g.ya' bzang pa rin chen nyi ma la gdams pa/ kye ma dal ba 'di ni lan cig g.yar po tsam// yun ring bdag gis dbang bar mi 'gyur na// 'byor pa'i skabs su phan bde mi bsgrub bam// rang sems nang du khug la bsam mno thong*// de la'ang dge ba'i blo ni yad yud de// mun rub glog 'gyu'i snang ba ji lta bas// dran pa'i mod la brtson 'grus cis mi rtsom// rang sems nang du khug la bsam mno thong*// 'dus byas thams cad skad cig 'gyur ba'i chos// brtags na snying po yod pa mi snang bas// 'dod pa don du gnyer ba ma 'khrul lam// rang sems nang du khug la bsam mno thong*// kun rdzob 'di kun rmi lam yul bzhin du// ma dpyad 'khrul ngo tsam du nyams dga' mod// rig pas bshig na grub pa 'ga' gda' 'am// rang sems nang du khug la bsam mno thong*// 'jig rten bya ba kun la phar bltas na// blo thub yid brtan rung ba ma mthong la// bsam gyin yi mug mi ldang dbang 'dug gam// rang sems nang du khug la bsam mno thong*// 'byor pa'i dus na char sprin lta bur 'du// gud na mthong ba'i sar yang mi 'khor bas// nye du 'khor la dga' ba ci la skye// rang sems nang du khug la bsam mno thong*// bu med mi gtsang ba yi gong bu ste// nor rdzas zug rngu 'byung ba'i gzhi ma yin// bzang ngan grags pa 'di dag tshig min nam// rang sems nang du khug la bsam mno thong*// yul mkhar bzang yang sdug bsngal spel ba'i gnas/ srid gsum bde ba thams cad nyam chung ste// de la chags nas chen po'i bde 'dor ram// rang sems nang du khug la bsam mno thong*// byis pa'i dus nas bsam med bya bas 'das// gzhon nu lang tsho'i sgang la zla dgas 'byams// dar la babs nas chags sdang dbang stong ngam// rang sems nang du khug la bsam mno thong*// ma tshor ngang la rga ba'i rkun pos zin// blo dang 'byung bzhi lhan cig gud rtsa na// dam pa'i lha chos med pa'i sdug bsngal ldang*// rang sems nang du khug la bsam mno thong*// 'di nas 'pho nges gar 'gro'i gdengs med la// bar do'i 'jigs pa thams cad yid la dran// mal mtha' ngu bas bskor tshe mi 'gyod dam// rang sems nang du khug la bsam mno thong*// tshe 'di long med do nub kho na la// glo bur rkyen gyis mi 'chi'i gdengs med pas// sdod grabs gshom ra gting nas ci zhig bgyi// rang sems nang du khug la bsam mno thong*// da nang mi la phyi dro ro zhes grag

/sang nas ming tsam lus pa mthong bzhin du// rang nyid rtag tu re ba'i dred po khyod// rang sems nang du khug la bsam mno thong*// phan re'i nye 'khor thams cad shul du bor// bsags pa'i nor rdzas thams cad cam gyis bzhag /gcig pur bskyas chen 'degs tshe smre sngags 'chor// rang sems nang du khug la bsam mno thong*// kye ma tshe 'di skad cig re res 'jig par phyogs// srog ni zil pa 'dra ste yal du nye// dbugs ni ba thag 'dra ste shin tu rnyi// rang sems nang du khug la bsam mno thong*// snying po med la snying po re re nas// dal ba yid bzhin nor bu stong par slog /gtan gyi dgos 'dod rlung la bskur nus sam// rang sems nang du khug la bsam mno thong*// sngon bsags dbang gis thengs gcig 'byor pa'i lus// gtad pa mdo med gcig gis skyel bar rings// da dung yin du re ba'i bsam rlag po// rang sems nang du khug la bsam mno thong*// phan pa'i gtam zhig thos na skyo sun ldang*// dgos med long gtam sgrog la nyin mtshan brel// las 'bras sun 'byin bag med bsgrub phod dam// rang sems nang du khug la bsam mno thong*// gcig pur sdod tshe skyid 'dod 'du 'dzi bsam// mang po'i khrod na ngo dga' gsar 'grogs che// res 'ga' zhum dang res 'ga' nga rgyal bas/ rang sems nang du khug la bsam mno thong*// che la 'gran 'dod mnyam la phrag dog cing*// dman la brnyas bcos gzhan du zug rngu can// zhe la chos brgyad 'tshangs pa'i pad+ma dkar// rang sems nang du khug la bsam mno thong*// bzang po 'dod nas ngan pa'i bya ba rtsom// skyid 'dod sdug bsngal rgyu la rtag par spyod// rang sems ma thul gzhan ma'i slob dpon bgyid// rang sems nang du khug la bsam mno thong*// gong ma mi bkur ci mdzad nyes par mthong*// dman pa mi skyong sgo gsum ngal sar gtod// bar ma rnams la gzhogs smod 'phya yis 'debs// rang sems nang du khug la bsam mno thong*// bstod cing bsngags pa'i yul ni rang la byed// smad cing mi snyan tshig gis gzhan skyon gleng*// zang zing phyogs su gdam ngag thams cad spung*// rang sems nang du khug la bsam mno thong*// bdag la gus na gzhan gyi phyogs dang 'brel// ngo srung lus ngag yid gsum 'bungs la rtsom// 'byor pa pha rol slu ba'i ched du spungs// rang sems nang du khug la bsam mno thong*// thos bsam sgom pa cung zad bgyis pa yang*// 'jig rten grags pa'i ched dang sgrub par thal// tshul khrims bsrung ba'ang gzhan mas mchod du re// rang sems nang du khug la bsam mno thong*// slob pa'i dus su le los phyi bshol byas// sgom pa'i dus su rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzis g.yengs// phyis nas gzhan ma'i slob dpon byed par rings// rang sems nang du khug la bsam mno thong*// skye bo rnams kyis bzang por bsams nas bkur// rang nyid dkor gyis smyo nas bag 'khyal spyod// btsan sa rdzun la re ba'i pad+ma dkar// rang sems nang du khug la bsam mno thong*// rang gis chos bzhin ma byas rnam smin gyis// 'khor slob phal cher ban ma hor 'drar song*// dad zas ma 'ju phyi ma'ang ngan 'gro'i rgyu// rang sems nang du khug la bsam mno thong*// kye ma

snyigs ma'i dus su sna thag mgor dkris nas// mtho dman cig la blo rtse ma gtad na// rgyu snyom kho nas dgos pa mi 'grub pas// rang sems nang du khug la bsam mno thong*// tshe yun shes bya'i mtha' la zad pa med// bstan las snying po tsam zhig blang byas nas// gcig pur dben par bsgoms na mi 'thad dam// rang sems nang du khug la bsam mno thong*// rgyal khams phal cher chos min kho nas mgu /chos min bgyid du rgyal ba'i gsung dang 'gal// mi rnams ji ltar zer yang chos bzhin gyis// shi 'am gson kyang 'gyod par mi 'gyur ro// chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba sems yin la// sems nyid rtag tu dran pas btul gyur na// srid gsum sems can thams cad dgrar langs kyang*// ba spu'i rtse mo tsam yang bskyod mi nus// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos thams cad// shes rab mig gis bltas kyang 'ga' zhig kyang*// rnyed min de la rang gi rig pa zer// gzhan gyis brjod pa'i mthu yis shes mi 'gyur// de skad grub pa'i 'byung gnas ra lung thel// gangs can lte ba de yi ri bo'i spor// bod yul shar gyi dge slong spong ba pa// mi pham pad+ma dkar po zhes bya bas// rang la bskul ma gzhan la bslab byar bkod// des kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa ring gnas shog /mi lus thob tshe bshes gnyen ma bstan na// rgya che zab mo'i chos dang mi mjal bas// legs nyes blang dor dbye ba phyed mi 'gyur// mang thos sbyangs pa gyis zhes snying gi gtam// legs par sbyangs kyang bsgoms la ma 'bad na// bshad pa thog tu khel ba ches bka' zhing*// rkyen ngan byung tshe gnyen pos zin mi thub// rtse gcig sgrub pa gyis zhes snying gi gtam// dang po'i dus su 'du 'dzi ma spangs na// sngar goms sred pa langs pa'i dga' gdungs kyis// rtog pa'i gseb na dran shes btsal rnyed tsam// 'jig rten bya ba thong zhes snying gi gtam// sgom pa'i dus su dran pas ma bzhur na// byings rgod rmongs pa gsum gyi re mos sam// yang na mi rtog had por 'khyam nyen gda'// sgo gsum srang du chug ces snying gi gtam// dwangs snyigs phyed tshe lhug par ma bzhag na// ha cang bcings pas sems kyi 'char sgo ldang*// bgag kyin mang du song na skyo sun skye// ma yengs dran pa bsten zhes snying gi gtam// gnas pa'i dus su zhen med ma bskyangs na// bde gsal mi rtog la zhen khams gsum 'phen// gtan don thar pa'i dge legs mi 'byung bas// ma bcos lhug par skyongs zhes snying gi gtam// bstan pa thob tshe sgom de ma stor na// nyams kyi ting 'dzin de la yun ring 'byam// 'gog pa gzhan du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dka'// sems rgyu kun la dpyod ces snying gi gtam// rig pas brtag tshe snang thog ma bltas na// stong nyid rang ngo rig par mi 'gyur zhing*// gang shar sgom du 'gro ba mi srid pas// tshogs drug thad gar khyer zhes snying gi gtam// sgom skye'i dus su mos gus mi che na// yon tan gong ma'i 'bras bu 'byung dka' zhing*// bzang ngan snang ba lam du khyer mi btub// dad gus 'gyur med ces zhes snying gi gtam// kun tu mi rtag 'chi ba ma bsgoms na// tshe srog g.yo ba sprin ltar gtugs gyur pas// long yod phyi bshol byas na rang nyid bslus// skyo shas nges 'byung skyes zhes snying gi gtam// rtogs kyang gzhan don bsgrub la mi brtson na// sgrib gnyis dgra yi mgo bo mi choms shing*// thar pa'i grong khyer chen por bgrod dka' bas// kun rdzob rten 'brel sgrigs zhes snying gi gtam// zhes pa rtse chen mngon dga' chos sde'i slob dpon rab 'byams byams pa bstan pa'i gsal byed la gdams pa'o//

༈ rten 'brel gyi sgom thabs gnyis kyi zhal gdams tshigs su bcad pa/ rnal 'byor rig pa'i seng ge la gnang ba/ thams cad mkhyen dang 'gro ba'i mgon// rtsa ba'i bla mar phyag 'tshal lo// dben pa'i ri la bsam gtan gyi// khang bu shin tu yid 'ong bar// bse ru lta bur 'dug par bya// grogs ldan smra ba bcad nas te// rnam snang gi ni chos bdun gyis// rang nyid thub par bltas byas nas// lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor bya// mdun du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la// brten te rang sems 'dul bar bya// 'das la mi mno ma 'ongs pa// mi sems da ltar dpyad mi bya// ma yengs ma bcos lhug par bzhag /mar me'i rtse mo bcings pa dang*// chu bo'i rgyun bzhin kun tu bskyangs// gang mthong gang snang de nyid las// stong nyid gzhan du mi rnyed pas// tshogs drug mi spong thog tu bzhag /mi mthun thams cad grogs su 'khyer// ji ltar shar yang bzo mi bya// byams dang snying rje'i chu yis brlan// byang chub sems kyis yun du bskyangs// rjes la dge ba rgya cher spel// sems can kun la bgo bar bya// sdig pa mtha' dag sbyang bar bgyi// kun gyi duḥkha gang yin 'khur// mos gus kyi ni grogs mchog btsal// de ltar bshad 'di mdo tsam ste// bla ma'i gsung gis brgyan par byos// zhes pa'o// ༈ mdo khams bya btang bstan pa rgyal mtshan la gnang ba/ gsang spyod dang 'brel ba'i zhal gdams/ dpal ldan rje btsun nā ro pa// brgyud par bcas la phyag 'tshal lo// rtog pa'i gzhi rtsa chod gyur na// lha 'drer 'dzin pa rang sar dag /'khor 'das thams cad gcig tu 'dres// mi mthun rkyen rnams grogs su song*// spang dang blang ba bya rgyu zad// lta ba'i go cha de ldan yang*// dgos 'dod kun gyi 'byung sa de// bla ma yin pas gsol ba thob// ci mdzad legs par mthong gyur pas// mos gus ltem rkyang mi gda' na// tshe 'di 'tshang rgya the tshom med// res 'ga' spros bcas drag po yis// snang ba'i thog tu rtsal sbyang zhing*// res 'ga' shin tu spros med kyis// stong nyid steng du brdar sha dpyad// skabs su dmigs pa'i mtshon cha yis// kun rdzob 'khrul pa'i rdzun 'tshang 'don// kun tu byar med ngang la bzhag

/ma yengs mi sgom 'di ltar zhog /bdag tu 'dzin pa ma bcom na// dben pa 'grim kyang don go chung*// de phyir thog brdzis spyod pa yis// re dang dogs pa'i mgo bo chog /chos brgyad blo ngan yul nas thon// gnyis su med pa'i mdud pa phrol// de skad brjod pa cha shas tsam// bla ma'i gdams pas gnad grol gces// shu bhaṃ// ༈ lta sgom spyod pa mdo tsam bstan pa snying por 'jug pa/ rdo rje 'chang dbang bla ma la// kun nas dad pas phyag bgyis te// snying po'i don la 'jug pa'i gtam// chu thig tsam zhig 'di na'o// rtogs dang mi rtog 'khor ba dang*// mya ngan 'das pas ma gus pa'i// thog ma dang ni tha ma med// lhan gcig ces pa gnyug ma'i sems// yod min med pa ma yin zhing*// gnyis min gnyis yin min des na// rtag dang chad dang dngos po dang*// dngos po med las rnam par 'das// de nyid bsam gyis mi khyab cing*// gzhal du med pa dpag med phyir// gzhan gyi brjod pas mi rtog pas// rang gis rig par bya ba yin// gzhon nu ma yi myong ba'i bde// 'di lta 'o zhes smra mi nus// de bzhin sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*// ji bzhin brjod la tshig gis 'phongs// 'on kyang rgyal ba'i yon tan kun// skyed pa'i ma ma bla ma yi// drin gyi skad cig gcig nyid la// 'char ro thabs gzhan mang pos min// stong pa min la mi dmigs shing*// stong pa nyid du'ang mi bsam la// yid la byed pas mi dpyad par// lhug pa nyid du gnas par bya// gang tshe sems glang ma thul na// dran pa'i lcags kyus yan mi btang*// bcings par gyur pas de ngal na// rgya yan glod dang rang sar gnas// gang dag kun la blta 'dod na// des ni gang la'ang blta mi bya// ji ltar lta ba yongs bral na// de des shes bya kun la ltos// 'gro ba dang ni 'chag dang nyal// 'dug pa gnas skabs thams cad du// mtshan mar 'dzin pas mi g.yeng bar// ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du zhog

/de lta mod kyang sgyu ma mkhan// mkhas pas sgyu ma 'gyed pa bzhin// stong pa nyid las snying rje'i blos// 'gro rnams 'ching byed mi zad pa// de des rnal 'byor grol byed pa// dper na nags la mched pa'i me// rlung gis bskyod pa lta bu'o// kyai dang po'i las can dag /bying na mi rtag blo shas bskyed// rgod na srid pa'i nyes mtshang 'dru// rmugs na rig pa ngar bskyed do// ces pa 'di pad+ma dkar pos nyung ngu la mos pa'i ngor bgyis pa'o// ༈ phyogs su yon tan snang ba spro mdzad pas// nyes pa'i mun sel 'gro ba bsil byed pa// 'jam dkar ku muta gnyen de bdag gi ni// yid mtshor ring du rol bar mdzad du gsol// 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di la phar ltos dang*// skye dga' na 'chi bzhi po re mos te// ci la bsams kyang thar bar mi 'dug pas// da ni thar pa'i lam chen btsal na legs// 'jig rten bya ba kun la phar ltos dang*// byas pa thams cad sdug bsngal kho na'i rgyu// ci la bsam kyang phan pa mi 'dug pas// da ni gtan 'dun dge ba bsgrubs na legs// tshe 'di snang ba dag la phar ltos dang*// sdug bsngal bde bar bzung bas chags pa nyid// ci la bsam kyang blo thub mi 'dug pas// da ni dam pa'i chos la 'bad na legs// nye du dgra bo rnams la phar ltos dang*// dgra gnyen ma nges 'phral mar 'gyur ba ste// ci la bsam kyang 'brel ba mi 'dug pas// da ni mtshan ldan bla ma bsten na legs// nor rdzas mnga' ris yongs la phar ltos dang*// bsags bsrung brlag pas zug rngu skye ba'i rten// ci la bsam kyang snying po mi 'dug pas/ da ni 'phags pa'i nor bdun bsags na legs/ mi rtag nges pa'i tshe la phar ltos dang*/ yud tsam mi sdod long med g.yo ba ste/ ci la bsams kyang rtag pa mi 'dug pas// da ni brtson 'grus drag pos nyams len legs// tha snyad gzhung lugs kun la phar ltos dang*// thams cad rang sems 'khrul par byed pa'i rkyen// ci la bsam kyang zad pa mi 'dug pas// da ni bla ma'i gdams ngag bsten na legs/

ma dul sems kyi glang por phar ltos dang*/ yul la mngon dga'i zhen pas 'phyo ba nyid// ci la bsams kyang bzlog pa mi 'dug pas/ da ni dran pa'i ra bar bcug na legs// bcos ma'i sgom pa kun la phar ltos dang*/ bying rmugs rnam par rtog pa'i brje len te// ci la bsams kyang grol ba mi 'dug pas// da ni ma bcos lhug par bzhag na legs// blos byas lta ba kun la phar ltos dang*// nyon mongs rkyen gyis sleb dus rgya yan shor// ci la bsams kyang dgos pa mi 'dug pas/ da ni rang sems gtan la phab na legs// tshogs drug snang ba kun la phar ltos dang*// med bzhin snang ba'i skyu mar zhen pa nyid/ ci la bsams kyang spong ba mi 'dug pas// da ni gang shar steng du bzhag na legs// 'gro drug sems can kun la phar ltos dang*// thog med dus nas bskyangs pa'i drin can ma// ci la bsam kyang phyogs ris mi 'thad pas// da ni brtse ba'i thabs kyis bskyangs na 'thad// rang gzhan dge legs kun la phar ltos dang*// dkon mchog dam pa'i drin las byung bas na// ci la bsams kyang rang sgor mi brtsi bar// da ni gdungs shugs chen pos mos gus legs// lus dang ngag gis byed par phar ltos dang*// dga' dang mi dga' thams cad 'di yis byas// ci la bsam kyang bab col mi bya bar// da ni yid kyis brtags nas dpyad na legs// mdor na dam pa'i mdzad par phar ltos dang*// sgrub dang spong bar 'os pa legs byed kyis// ci la bsams kyang snyoms sems mi bskyed par// da ni spang blang bstun te byas na legs// de skad snying rje'i tshor nas pad+ma dkar// dad pa'i bser bus dal gyis bskul ba na// snyan tshig dri bsung dam pa 'di spro bas// blo gsal bung ba'i tshogs rnams dga' gyur cig /ces pa'i tshigs bcad pad dkar dri bsung zhes pa 'di yang*/ lha khang nas chos mdzad gos dkar sgrol mas brgya 'bul bco lnga tsam bgyis dus bskul ba bzhin/

mkhar chu dung gi brag ri/ byang chub snying pos ngogs/ rin po che'i gling*/ nor bu spung pa'i gzhal med kyi khang par sbyar ba'o// ༈ snyigs dus tshe thung lhag par rkyen ngan mang*// 'chi bdag bdud kyi dal brel mi blta gzhom// mdza' bshes nor rdzas 'dzom yang der mi phan// lha chos snying nas mdzod dang rigs kyi bu// col chung byis pa'i gtam la dgos pa ci// tha snyad tshig gi pha mtha' su yis chod// kha bshad khram du zad pas rkyen mi theg /bla ma'i man ngag 'tshol dang rigs kyi bu// mthong thos shes pa bkag pas ga la khegs// sems 'dzin rtog pa'i ri mo 'khor ba'i rgyu// ma bcos lhug par 'jog pa sangs rgyas lam// de la rtse gcig bsten dang rigs kyi bu// sna tshogs yul la shes pa tsam 'phro yang*// gang shar steng du glod pa'i gnad zin na// chu la chu gzhag lta bur gnyis med pa'i// rang mtshang rig pa 'di sgoms rigs kyi bu// gsal yang stong pa gzhan du mi stong zhing*// stong yang snang ba 'gag par ma gyur na// zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i lam yin pas// chu bo'i rgyun bzhin skyongs dang rigs kyi bu// zhes pa sde pa chos rgyal rin chen la g.yul rgyal rdzong du gdams pa'o// ༈ chags sdang byas pa'i rnam smin rang la 'byung*// dgra gnyen mi brtan 'phral mar 'gyur nas 'gro// de la a 'thas byed rnams rang 'khrul bas// kun la snyoms pa'i phan sems brten mdzod dang*// gshis ngan ser sna sgos su gal rnams kyis// nor dang mnga' thang tha ma sus khyer med// gtan bde bzhed na bdog pa ci yod pa// lhag bsam dag pas sbyin par thong dang dge /bya bzhag phal cher don med sdug bsngal rgyu// phan nges sdig spong dge ba bsgrub pa nyid// de la dbang yod dus su ma gdams na// phyis nas bsam blo thog tu 'khyol bar dka'// 'khor ba'i nye du mdza' yang 'ching ba'i sgrog /gtan gyi blo gtad thub pa bla ma yin// de la mos gus ltem brkyang ma shor na// gang bsams 'grub par nges so dad can ma// 'di yang lha khang nas a che dkon mchog bu khrid la srib mo mkhar du gdams pa'o//

༈ lam zab gdam pa'i snying po bzhugs so// rje btsun ngag gi dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gang thar pa'i grong khyer du// 'jug pa de der thog ma dang*// bar dang mtha' mar dge ba gang*// lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor ro// lus dang ngag yid ye shes kyi// dri ma dag bya dag byed kyi// mchog des bzang po smin mdzad pa'i// rdo rje slob dpon de la 'dud// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum// gcig tu dril nas gsol gdab na// gang 'dod re ba skong ba'i rje// yid bzhin nor bu de la 'dud// khams gsum dang ni g.yo ba gang*// gdod nas grub pa'i dkyil 'khor zhes// rnam pa gang gis khyab byed ni// dpal ldan bla ma'o de la 'dud// de yang gang zhig dran pa yis// 'khor ba'i nyes pa drungs phyung nas// sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid du// byed pa de la'ang phyag 'tshal lo// ji ltar ji ltar btsal gyur pa// de ltar de ltar rnyed dka' ba'i// gsang ba kun gyi gsang ba che// rang gis rig bya de la 'dud// brtan dang g.yo ba de'i rang bzhin// de nyid rnam pa thams cad pas// chu dang rlabs ltar ro mnyam pa'i// gsang ba der ni phyag bgyi'o// sgrib pa kun las nges grol bas// skye ba med cing 'gag med kyang*// rnam pa thams cad gzhan phan la// g.yel ba med la phyag 'tshal lo// de ni rdo rje 'chang gis bshad// dpa' bo chen po'i rim pas 'ongs// dpal ldan ngag gi dbang las thos// pad+ma dkar po'i sbyin bya'o// 'di yang chos rgyal bya'i rigs sa skyong mtsho skyes rdo rje'i bka'i ngor bgyis pa'o// ༈ dpal 'brug pa yab sras la phyag 'tshal lo// dran pa'i thigs pa yid la lhung bas kyang*// srid pa'i gdung bas glags rnyed mi 'gyur ba'i// dam chos bdud rtsi'i char pa spro mdzad pa// bka' rgyud sprin gyi phreng ba de dag rgyal// nyam nga 'khor ba'i btson ra 'jigs rung 'dir// skyid du res kyang mi bzad sdug bsngal gyis// khor mo gtses pa'i zug rngu 'tshal ba'i yid// dam pa'i chos la gdung ba su yis lhogs// 'jig rten mi rtag g.yo ba sprin bzhin dang*// tshe srog mi brtan rtswa kha'i zil 'dra dang*// dbugs ni yal skyen na bun ltar shes la// snyom sems le lo skye ba'i go skabs ci// rgyal ba rnams dang nam yang mi phyed pa'i// rdo rje slob dpon zhabs kyi pad+mo la// 'di phyi kun gyi re bltos byas gyur na// tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub la dka' rgyu ci// nam mkha'i khams kyi rjes song chos phung gis// pha mtha' bslabs shes tsam gyis ga nas rnyed// bla ma'i man ngag snying la zhen gyur na// chos rnams kun gyi rang mtshang khyod la ston// srid 'dir theg pa'i rnam grangs mang yod kyang*// bde bar gshegs rnams bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam// ma bcos lhug pa'i ngang du 'jog nus na// rgyal ba'i yon tan ma lus zhar la 'byung*// mi bsrun 'khor ba'i gnod pa rnams sbyor ba'i// nyon mongs dug lnga'i dgra thabs ji snyed pa// rang sems dran pa'i g.yul du 'dul ba las// sgrib gnyis sbyang ba'i mchog gzhan ga nas rnyed// 'gro drug pha mar shes nas drin lan du// rang don yal bar bor ba'i snying rje yis// rtag tu gzhan don 'ba' zhig lhur len las// tshogs gnyis gsog pa'i thabs mkhas su la yod// khams drug ldan pa'i rdo je'i lus gcun nas// g.yas g.yon 'pho ba nyi zla'i rlung bkag ste// 'dzag med bde ba'i 'gros bzhir slob rnams la// drod rtags yon tan thob la 'gyangs cha ci// dngos 'dzin gdon gyis sbyar ba'i sgyu ma rnams// rang rig ye shes ngang du ro snyom pa'i// brtul zhugs spyod pa'i ya lad sus gyon par// bdud bzhi dgra bos bar gcod ci la tshugs// srid gsum sbyor ba smyon pa'i gar bzhin dang*// tshe 'di'i snang ba rmi lam ji lta bar// kha tsam min pa snying nas mthong ba las// gzhan pa'i chos kyi dgos pa btsal nas ci// rmongs rnams go phyir mang po'i tshig spros mod// de dag dus kyi de la blta mi khom// shes ldan khyod nyid dran gsor nyung ngu'i gtam// me tog phreng ba chab kyis dran pa bzhin// mi dbang thugs kyi pad+ma can dga' ba'i// legs bshad ku mu ta rnams 'byed nus pa// rnam dpyod 'od dkar ci yang 'dzin pa ni// smra ba'i zla ba puṇ+ḍa rī ka yin// zhes za hor gyi rgyal brgyud rnam dpyod mtshungs pa med pa bsod nams dar zhing rgyas pa'i lha la/

pad+ma dkar pos lho brag mkhar chu nas gdams pa'o// ༈ mi khyod rang gi lus dbus rtsa dbu ma// 'od phung gi rnam pa'i stong ra'i nang*// sems skye med hūm̐ gi rnam par ltos/ spyi bor rje btsun bla ma bsgom// tshe 'di la chags shing zhen pa bskyur// mngon dga'i zhing du smon lam thob// pha bka' rgyud kun gyi ngo bo nyid// skyabs sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dngos// lha yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong kun// don gcig 'dus bla ma rin po che// blo rtse gcig gus pas gsol ba 'debs// rje thugs rje'i lcags kyus gzung mdzod la// nga khams gsum 'khor bar mi 'khyams pa// dpal mngon par dga' bar mi 'khrugs pa'i// 'khor dag pa'i khrod du skye bar mdzod// ngag de skad brjod cing yid la bsgom// mchog dge ba'i bshes kyis hūm̐ brjod pas// sems hūm̐ gi snang ba yar yar song*// pha bla ma'i thugs kar thim pa'i mthar// de mngon dga'i zhing du song bar gyur// ༈ khams gsum gyi sems can kun gyi phyir// dpal rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya// don de phyir rang lus spyan ras gzigs// sku mdog dkar zhi zhing mdzes pa can// phyag dang pos thugs kar thal mo sbyar// 'og ma gnyis shes phreng pad dkar bzung*// drang srong gi cha lugs skyil krung bcas// spyir sems can gyi kha rjer yi dam khyod// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kun gyis bskrun// bod 'bangs kyi lha skal nyid du gtad// sgos rgan po nga yi blo bltos bcas// tshe 'di phyi bar do'i skyabs gnas zhu// snying thag pa'i 'o dod 'bod lags kyis// mi sdig can bdag la thugs rjes gzigs// snying gar zla dbus hrīḥyig mthar// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ gis bskor// sngags nyung la 'thus pa yi ge drug /'di bgrangs pa'i phan yon bsam mi khyab// dus gtan gyi don kun bsgrub pa la// yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che// rkyen bar chad bzlog pa'i rgyal po yin// sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bsgrub pa la// byin rlabs kyi tshan ka bsam mi khyab// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/

sngags 'phreng las thugs ka'i 'od zer 'phros// gang la gang 'dul gyi sprul pa'i skus// sems can gyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs// mgon sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad mchod// slar byin rlabs bsdus nas rang la thim// yul snang tshad sku la grags tshad gsung*// yid dran tshad thugs kyi rol pa la// blo rtse gcig mos pas gsol ba 'debs// lha khyed dang mnyam pa'i dngos grub stsol// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐// bya rigs kyi nang so bkras yes kyi// chos skal du pad+ma dkar pos gtad// ༈ thos bsam pad+mo'i tshal du bag phebs shing*// bsgom byung dri gsung gis myos legs bshad kyis// mgrin rnga brdung de snyan par grags pa'i mod// char sprin 'brug sgra can la mgrin sngon bzhin// dga' ba rgyas pa'i tshig gi ca co yis// rjes su yi rang ci yang 'dir byas pa'i// gtam cha phan tshun sbrel ba'i pho nyar song*// gang gis bsnyad pa de ni bdag cag kyang*// sna tshogs snang ba'i cha nas chos dang ni// rang bzhin med pa kun rdzob chos nyid de// cir yang ma grub pa nyid thams cad du// snang bas 'di ga bar snang stong pa bzhin// don de chos dbyings kun 'gro zhes par bsnyad// rnam pa kun ldan stong pa'ang zhes bya ste// rnam pa kun yang zad pa'i dbyings de la// 'gyur ba med pa'i bde bar bzhag pas na// rnam med 'od gsal gdod ma'i sems kyi gshis// rnam kun rnam pa med par mi phyed pa// 'di ni nged kyang phyag rgya chen por 'dod// zung 'jug ye shes tshad ldan de la zer// rgya bod shing rta'i mchog rnams kun dang mthun// dam pa khyod dang gnas kyi bskal gyur kyang*// nges don 'du 'bral med pa de ru 'grogs// cha tsam brjod pa'i legs bshad 'di gson la// yang yang springs yig gleng mo byas par 'dod// ces gzhung brgya smra ba'i dbang po shes rab grags pa'am mchog grong pa chen po zhes pas mdo khams sman gyi dgon nas 'bul skyel dang bcas byung ba'i lan du brdzongs pa'o//

༈ zla ba mkha' la rgyu ba'i zer ma la// bdud rtsi zhes brjod skye bos bstod bkur na// dbyangs can snying gar rol pa'i snyan dngags tshig /yid kyi gdung sel gtso bor su mi len// pha ma'i brgyud dag 'bangs kyis 'khur mkhan mang*// spyod pa ya rabs mna' mtho chad la 'dzem// mnga' thang skyong shes dgra 'joms dpung pa can// mi chen rgyal po mchog la dgos pa yin// chab 'og la byams bran la nye ring chung*// skye bos smad dogs 'phyon ma'i bya ba bgag /rang spyod rgyal po'i thugs rje 'brang shes pa// btsun mo bsngags 'os byed na dgos pa yin// yas kyi rjer gus mas kyi 'bangs la byams// spyod pa mdzangs thon kha 'jam zhe mi gnag /'khrug na dpal la gzhan zhi chog shes ldan// rgyal po'i gnangs chen byed na dgos pa yin// nor phyir gtang don mi 'chor ngo tsha bsten// phan lan dus su 'jal ba'i khrel gzhung srong*// su nyer mi 'dzugs thug na srog la bsdo// drung 'khor dra ma byed na dgos pa yin// rgan rabs tshig nyan gzhon pa skyong la mkhas// spyi pa'i tshig 'dzin rngan pa'i dbang mi gtong*// mnyam la 'grogs shes kun tu rgyu drang ba// skye bo gtso rgan byed na dgos pa yin// bdag pos ngo lta gzhan la snying mi sems// khyim gyi so tshigs mkhas la dam lhod ran// nang nub las rim khyim mdzes chags sdang chung*// bu mo mi go 'grim na dgos pa yin// ma bcol las la smyon pa bzhin mi 'jug /bskos pa'i bya bar re dkar mi byed cing*// rje g.yog bar du phra ma'i tshig mi 'byin// mi kha byams po byed na dgos pa yin// nad dang rgyu rkyen shes bya sad mdas brtag /nad pa'i lang tsho shes nas skabs ran pa'i// sman dang spyad bya nga lo yangs la grims// sman pa gzhan phan byed na dgos pa yin// lta ba'i gyad ldan sgom pa'i rtsal gsum rgyas// spyod pas las chen gang la'ang 'thul chud pa'i// sangs rgyas bstan dang dam tshig gces par 'dzin// sngags pa bdud dgrar chas na dgos pa yin// dbyibs la srin bu'i shul rjes mi ston cing*// sdebs legs yid gzhungs dbang gis tshig dag la// snag shog smyug gu'i bar du gtsang sbra ldan// yig mkhan mkhas par 'jug na dgos pa yin// kun la snying snyoms byas na dga' ba brdal// byams pa'i chus bcus snying rje'i sa bon las// sems kyi myu gu bskyed pa'i so nam 'di// bla med byang chub bsgrub na dgos pa yin// phyi yi tshugs khyer yod la 'gying bag chung*// nang du blang 'das nye tshe gnyen pos sleb// bar du brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin rlom sems med// btsun pa btsun por 'jog na dgos pa yin// dang por bla ma bsten nas thos pa btsal// de la bsam pas nan tan bskyed nas skyong*// nges shes skyes nas sgom la bsgril shes pa// chos la mdo yod byed na dgos pa yin// bzang ngan su zhig gong du shor yang bzod// lto gos rnyed par rtseg gsum cang mi byed// kha zhe med par spyod pa bag mi yangs// bzang po'i khrod du 'tshang na dgos pa yin// sbyin pas bos nas snyan pa'i gtam gyis 'drid// don spyod bag phab phebs nas don mthun sbyar// rang don dgra bor 'dzin pa'i rnam thar 'di// sems dpa' gzhan don byed na dgos pa yin// 'chi ba dran pas snyom las 'dug mi phod// rgyu 'bras shes pas tshe 'di'i zhen pa bor// dran shes bsten nas rang sems yan mi gtong*// sgom chen rab gcig byed na dgos pa yin// rmongs par yang yang bshad pas go ba bskyed// blo gsal zur smos go la snying po bsgril// tshig don srang la gzhal ba'i dogs gcod bya// mkhas pa 'chad nyan byed na dgos pa yin// phas rgol blun por 'dug na ya mi bsrang*// mkhas pa yin na rigs pa'i lam drang por// dgag dang rang lugs bzhag der rtsod pa spang*// smra ba'i 'dun sa 'grim na dgos pa yin// dkyus sa bstan nas rta yi rtse ba bzhin// dgos pa thob phyir bsdus don srol phye nas// tshig rgyan mtshams sbyar brgal lan ran par bri// bstan pa'i dgongs 'grel rtsom na dgos pa yin// zhes 'di lha yi mtshan 'dzin pa'i// khri lcam gang la rtsom pa'i dper// pad+ma dkar pos tshig 'di dag

/rgyal po'i khab tu byas pa yin// ༈ kye 'o srid par gdung byed tsha ba'i zil// ma lus gzhil ba'i ga pur rtag 'thul ba// dwags po'i bka' rgyud tsan dan nags klung 'dra'i// bla ma gnyis pa gar yod de bsten 'tshal// skye bo ser sna'i 'ching bas bcings gyur pa// mi bzad 'khor ba'i btson rar yang yang lhung*// de zlog sbyin las lhag pa'i tshul med pas// bsags tshad chos bzhin sbyin la spyod par mdzod// ngan 'gror 'phen byed sdig go mi dge'i las// de dag rnam smin gzigs nas cung zad kyang*// mi dge bcu yi las lam ma mdzad dang*// yon tan kun gzhi tshul khrims de gar 'dug /gzhan gyi bstod pa'i yul yang de lta na// de dag gis smad bdag la gnod min pas// tshig mtshon gzhan yang zung rngu'i gzhi thams cad// bden pa ma lags btang snyoms bzhag pas mthus// dge la drod gzung mi dgos thub tshad byas// brtson la bar chad 'byung ba chos nyid pas// 'jigs par mi bya dngos grub sna 'dren yin// de phyir rtag sbyor gus sbyor khyed kyis bsten// 'jig rten rgan rabs rnams kyi tshig la nyan// mdzangs dang yid gzhungs rnams bzhin bag ldan byas// chen po'i rjes su phebs dang shes rab kyi// ci 'dod mod la 'byung bar the mi tshom// mang por brjod kyang tshig yin don bsdu na// mtshan ldan bla ma nyid la blo gtad nas// lhag par gsol ba 'debs pa 'di kho nas// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'grub kyi gzhan ci smos// de skad sa skyong sras mo dad shugs can// sgrol ma zla mdzes snyan du cung zad tsam// pad+ma dkar pos bsrings 'di bzhin dpyad na// thub dbang dgyes pa'i spyod ldan 'gyur ba yin// ces rje btsun bsam 'phel nas sgrol ma zla mdzes la pad+ma dkar pos gdams pa'o// ༈ rjod byed tshig gi steng du glegs bam mang*// brjod bya don gcig ston la thams cad 'khril// de phyir gcig shes kun grol bka' brgyud kyi// bla ma'i zhabs la rnam kun phyag bgyi'o// 'jig rten phal cher lha zhes mchog tu lta// de kun dbang por bcas pa'ang 'jigs mthong tshe// sangs rgyas nyid la skyabs zhur 'ong 'dis su// dkon mchog gsum las lhag pa'i dpon ci dgos// de la skyabs zhus de yi 'bangs zhugs yin// des na mi mnyes spong dang mnyes byed dgos// de yang sdig spang dge ba sgrub pa ste// dge sdig sems la rag pas de 'dul bya// lus ngag yid kyi las la dran pa yis// sdig gam dge ba yin brtags sdig gyur na// dbang po'i sgo sdoms spyod las zlog pa dang*// dge na de rjes drod rig spyod pa yin// 'di ka rgyal ba kun gyis bcas pa'i khrims// dam chos 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i nying khu yin// yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten nyid du 'gyur// ngo lkog bya rgyu 'di la cang ma mchis// dge ba sgrub pa'i dge ba'ang gzhan phan nyid// rang nyid don gnyer pham pa lta bur lci// de phyir rdzogs sangs rgyas su sems bskyed nas// phyin chad spyod pa thams cad de rgyur gtang*// gzhan phan mngon shes thob na ches lhag la// de yang zhi gnas med na mi 'grub pas// rnal 'byor sgom pa'i man ngag tsam thos nas// dben par sgom pa mkhas pa'i bzhed pa yin// 'di ka shin tu rgyas pa mdo sde'i don// lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa ngos ma yin// nyon mongs 'jig pa'i shes rab 'di las skye// bdag 'dzin 'dul la med mi rung du 'dug

/sems 'dul dgos pa'ang rkang lham g.yogs pa'i dpe// mthong thos thams cad dgag tu mtha' mi chod// byed po sems tsam gzung 'dzin snang 'di kha// so sor rtog pa'i ngos na sprin bzhin zhi// 'on kyang 'di ni phra ba don dang zab// de phyir dad pa las gzhan gyis mi rtogs// bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs la rnyed sla bas// dus gsum sangs rgyas par nas bton pa 'dra// 'di ni chos mngon 'bum phrag mang po'i don// gtan la phab kyin nges shes skye ba'i gnad// lung rigs sbun pa'i sbubs na gnas pas na// snying po'i don gyi ming yang de la btags// nor 'dzin dbang mo bstan la mngon zhugs de'i// tshig bskul thos pa'i pad+ma dkar po yang*// snyan pa'i gtam phrad skye dgu'i yid mgu ba'i// ca co'i sgra bzhin 'di yis dger gyur cig /skyid shod nas rje btsun stag lung ma bstan pa rin po che la srid zhur mdzad pa de la gdams pa'o// ༈ de bzhin nyid kyi ngang bzhag tshe/ 'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad zhi// des na rgyal bas chos ci yang*// ma gzigs mi gzigs gzigs mi 'gyur// ma rig gnyid kyis bslad pa la// rmi lam bzhin du ci yang snang*// de la bden mthong rdzun lta bas// 'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa byung*// des na 'khrul dang ma 'khrul dang*// snang dang mi snang gcig du ma// yod med stong dang mi stong sogs// thams cad 'thad ces bla mas gsungs// de bas rnam par gzhag 'jog de// 'khrul pa can la dgos pa yin// de phyir bden gnyis gsung ba yang*// tha snyad la brten don rtogs phyir// tha snyad mdzub mo'i dgye dgu la// tshur shog la sogs brda 'phrod bzhin// don mtshon tsam gyi tshig sogs te// shes bya kun la dpyad mi lang*// lkug pas rmi lam rmis pa dang*// gzhon nu phrad pa'i bde myong bzhin// gzhan la ston par mi nus pa'i// mtshon don dpe bral dam pa'i dbyings// des na don dam cang med min// yod pa'i phyogs la shin tu 'gongs// yod med gnyis dang gnyis min min// de phyir dbu ma chen por bshad// rnam gcod rab tu mi gnas te// yongs gcod 'gyur med bde ba dang*// rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid ming*// ldog pas 'byed la don gcig pa// nged rang lugs kyi phyag chen yin// rnying ma ba rnams rdzogs chen zer// gzhi yang de 'o lam yang de// 'bras bu nyid kyang de kha bas// mthar thug theg pa gcig tu grub// chos kun de las gzhan min pas// rnam rtog thams cad chos kyi sku// nyon mongs thams cad ye shes phyir// mdun dang rgyab dang phyogs bcu ru// gang gang mthong ba de de nyid// thob par bya dang thob bya med// de bas sgom dang bsgom bya med// des na spyad bya spyod rgyu ci// thams cad mnyam nyid khyab brdal lo// khri dpon 'jigs byed rgyal po la// pad+ma dkar pos gdams pa'o//

༈ mkhar rtse nas gdams pa'o// 'khor 'das kyi chos kun las kyis byas// las dge sdig rang gi sems la thug /sems dge ba'i mi la phun tshogs kun// ngang gis 'byung bas rang sems thul// ces gdams pa'o// ༈ mtshan ldan gyi bla ma gcig la thug /mos gus kyi gdung ba shugs che na// sangs rgyas su 'gro ba'ang dka' ba min// blo rtse gcig gtod dang bden pa shes// ces dad pa can dge bsnyen tshe dbang skyabs la gdams pa'o// ༈ dgra yin nges bdag tu 'dzin pa thul// gnyen yin nges 'gro drug sems can skyongs// don bdag gzhan ma grub nam rtog pa// thabs byang sems zer te sangs rgyas rgyu// zhes kyang gdams pa'o// ༈ sems mal du bzhag pa ma shes na// gnas ri khrod mtho yang dben pa min// 'dre ngar 'dzin thul bar ma nus na// gnas dur khrod 'grims kyang gsang spyod min// rang lam las mi 'khyog ma shes par// las 'chad nyan smrar kyang 'gro don min// chos nyan nas rgyud zhir mi 'gro na// mi ldam ldem bsags pa gdul bya min// las dran bzhin shes bzhin mi spyod na// lus dra bas gtums kyang dge slong min// mi bskyangs pas gnod byed mi bzod na// 'phral smra ba bzod kyang bzod pa min// blo re dogs khong nas ma zhi na// ming 'khrul zhig byas kyang zhig po min// rang rang gi 'dul bar mi nus pa'i// mi ci zer nyan pa chos pa min// ces gnam mtsho do pa chen po chos grub dpal bzang po la gdams pa'o// ༈ khyod mig ltos gong ma'i mdzad par gyis// tshe 'di la zhen pa 'khor ba'i rgyu// rang gtan du 'ching bar byed pa'i sgrog /de ring du dor la bya btang zhes// sems chags zhen med pa'i spyod pa bsten// blo mi dgos dgu dgos 'khyams pa'i rgyu// chos shes bya mang bas mtha' mi chod// nyams len thabs shes nas de skyong ba// rje bla ma'i tshogs kyis mthun par gsungs// nyams sna tshogs 'char ba'i ltad mo la// kha phyi ltas byas na gong du spel// des gnas lugs mthong ba'i go mi chod// sems ma yengs de bzhin nyid la zhog

/ces rgyal ba bzang po la gdams pa'o// ༈ ting nge 'dzin la mnyam bzhag rab brtan nas// shes rab mig gis chos kun gzhal nus na// 'phags mchog go 'phang de ka'i mdun na 'dug /de bas bya ba bskyungs te rtse gcig sgoms// 'gro ba drug gi sngon rabs mang bstan te// phan bdes skyob pa drin lan 'jol ba yin// de bas rang don yid byed dor nas su// gzhan phan ched du sgrub la 'bad par gyis// bya ba gang yang lhag bsam gyis zin pa'i// dge bar 'gyur shes spyod par de zab pas// yengs pa med par bya spyod tshogs su bsgyur// chos kyi snying po byas kyang de zab bo// khams rngod nas bla ma dger rgan gyis 'bul chen byas dus gdams pa'o// ༈ bsod nams chen po'i gzi brjid mi zad pas// phas rgol grang ba'i reg bya kun mnan te// dro 'jam bde ba'i dpal gyis yongs skyong ba'i// pad+mo'i gnyen du 'khrungs pa de'i spyan sngar// 'phrin yig 'od zer stong gi khu ba yis// pad dkar snying ga bkrus pa'i ke sa rās// ngag gdam kun dga'i sbrang rtsi gsar 'bus pa// dge ba'i lang tsho rgyas byed legs par 'khums// ༈ 'khrig pa'i chos smra mu stegs gtan// bcar na 'dzug pas tsher ma'i phung po ste// bcol chung byi'u chung gnas su 'os mod kyi// blo chen rma bya'i rol gar rtse sa min// mi bzad 'khor ba'i 'jigs dang dpa' ba'i nang na cher grags shing*// phyi mar yon tan bdun ldan mtho ris 'byor// snying rjer goms pa gzhan don sgrub pa la// spro ba ji bzhin ting 'dzin la sbyang na// de la skyo ngal med pa 'byung ba'i phyir// ting nge 'dzin la 'jog pa'ang rig pa nyid// nges par legs bsgyur shes rab bsten 'os la// mang du thos pa med la shes rab kyang*// rnyed dkas lugs shes dge ba'i bshes gnyen la// gsan pa ci par rigs// zhes pa'ang*// sde pa dga' ldan pa sku gzhon pas snyan ngag la brten pa'i zhal gdams zhig ci nas dgos zhes nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor pad+ma dkar pos sbyar ba'o//

༈ phal cher mthon pos rjes su snyeg pa'i khrod// khyod ni drang po'i lugs 'dzin 'di kho nas// bla ma'i dam tshig thod du 'dzin nus zhes// rjes su yi rang bgyis so sngags 'chang ba// 'di na lung rigs slob ces ngal rnams phal// cal rgyugs dbyangs su len la brtson dbang gis// bslabs kyin rgyud reng 'gyur ba mthong bas su// snyigs dus thos bsam 'di yang shes pa skyo// rgyal ba'i gzhung lugs bdag nyid rnams// tshe 'di'i snang shas dbang gis lag len byed// phal cher nor phyir sgo gsum nus pa spungs// 'di 'dra'i sngags pa kun yang bstan dang 'gal/ rgyud bzhin gtan phab rang gis nyams blangs nas// dngos grub rnam gnyis kun phyir sgrub byed pa// bstan pa'i don min drag po'i las mi byed// 'di 'dra'i sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyi mar mthong*// snying po'i don sgom 'dod zer ri phug na// nyams kyi snang ba ban bun rer chags pas// tha mar gzhan las chags zhen che 'di rnams// dam chos gnad du song snyam nga mi bgyid// phyi dben nang dben mal dben de kho nar// skad cig ma yengs sgom pa'i bsam gtan par// chos brgyad mgo snyoms 'gyur phyir zhe 'dod med// de 'dra bka' brgyud bstan 'dzin gzhung ma yin// ces pad+ma dkar pos 'ug pa lung nas ma chen la gdams pa'o// ༈ mtshan grags pa che 'o ra lung na// tshe 'di na bde la phyi mar skyid// gnas lha mir skye ba thar pa'i snod// khong 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i nyes pa mthong*// rang zhi ba mya ngan 'das 'dod nas// thabs bslab pa gsum la slob pa yang*// chos spyod pa yin kyang dman pa'i lam// ma khams gsum 'gro la byams snying rjes// mchog bla med byang chub sems bskyed nas// dus skad cig rang don ma 'khris par// lam phar phyin drug la spyod pa 'di// khong dus gsum rgyal ba'i gzhung lam yin// sems bcos bslad med par rang rig na// gdangs lha sngags ting 'dzin rol mo yin// mchog thun mong dngos grub sgrub pa 'di// dpal rdo rje 'chang gi gsang lam yin// lus dngos por gnas pa'i rtsa rlung gcun/

sems stong pa nyid la spar zin byas// don gnas lugs mngon gyur sangs rgyas pa// rang sems las rnyed pa ngo mtshar che// zhes pad+ma dkar pos sngags grwa slob dpon kun dga' snying po la gdams pa'o// ༈ khyod snying nas dam pa'i chos bgyid na// rgyal khams kyi kha phyir ma 'brang bar// blo rtse gcig sangs rgyas bstan pa soms// bkur 'os kyi rje la gsol ba thob// bya byed la rang don ma 'khris na// 'phral sdig kyang phugs na dge ba che// tshe 'di skyid dang len mi bya zhing*// rkyen sdug pa spong blo ma byung na// las dge ba mi 'dzad sdig pa byang*// ma tshor ba'i ngang nas bsam pa 'grub// khong 'phags pa'i sa la yud kyis sleb// pha bka' brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug /tshe gcig la sangs rgyas the mi tshom// zhes pad+ma dkar pos rgyal byed tshal sngags grwa'i 'chad nyan pa dkon mchog bkra shis la gdams pa'o// ༈ sngon rabs kyi grub thob pad+ma 'byung*// mi khong gi byin rlabs zhugs pas kyang*// chos theg dgu'i rtse mo a ti la// don snying por sgril pa'i shes rab thob// de brag dmar smyon pa'i nyams len 'os// ka dag gi dbyings su sems bstim pas// bltar med zhig mthong ba med par mthong*// ming dbyings su rig pa thim pa zer// khong dbu phyag pa'i skad na gnyis med lo// don de tsam lta ba'i skal med na// lhun grub kyi snang ba bkrag po che// sgron ma bzhi 'gros kyi rim pas mthong*// lam gong nas gong du bgrod pas dga'// tshe 'di la de tsam long med na// gzhi bar do bzhi yi gnas skabs su// mtshon byed bsun mas dbugs phyin nas// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhing du bgrod// chos ci 'dod yon tan de nas 'byung*// zhes pa 'di brag dmar myon par pad+ma dkar pos 'brog ltas la phyin dus rgyal khang du smras pa'o//
